ALIGN for paper figures — draw a method-overview figure as an executable p5.js program that replays its own construction in named stages, exports SVG, and improves through pixel-only cross-model review whose gate is 'explain the method back from the figure alone, and is it worth looking at'. The method sets the relationships the figure must show, the chosen visual identity sets how its marks look, a composition source lends arrangements; the method may be the source's own (意临) or yours in its arrangement (风格迁移). Not for one-shot raster image generation.
